```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(future)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
```

Download GSE133382_AtlasRGCs_CountMatrix.csv and RGC_Atlas_coordinates.txt from https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE133382 and place into data folder.

```{r}
save <- here("Reclustering")
dir.create(save, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

data_dir <- here("data")
```

```{r}
counts <- read_csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "GSE133382_AtlasRGCs_CountMatrix.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# first column = gene names
gene_names <- counts[[1]]

# remove gene column
counts <- counts[, -1]

# convert to dataframe and set rownames
counts <- as.data.frame(counts)
rownames(counts) <- gene_names

# make Seurat object
rgc <- CreateSeuratObject(
  counts = counts,
  min.cells = 3,
  min.features = 200
)

rgc$sample_id <- sub("_.*", "", colnames(rgc))

table(rgc$sample_id)

metadata <- read.delim(
  file.path(data_dir,"RGC_Atlas_coordinates.txt"),
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

head(metadata)
colnames(metadata)
dim(metadata)

# make rownames = cell names
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$NAME

# add metadata to Seurat object
rgc <- AddMetaData(
  rgc,
  metadata = metadata[colnames(rgc), ]
)
```

```{r}
#helps to make the code not as memory heavy
plan(sequential)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 10 * 1024^3)

# 1. Add mito percent
rgc[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  rgc,
  pattern = "^mt-"
)

# 1b. Add ribosomal percent
rgc[["percent.ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(
  rgc,
  pattern = "^Rp[sl]"
)

# optional sanity check
VlnPlot(
  rgc,
  features = c("percent.mt", "percent.ribo"),
  pt.size = 0
)

# 2. Make sample + batch grouping
rgc$sample_batch <- paste(
  rgc$SampleID,
  rgc$BatchID,
  sep = "_"
)

# 3. Split by sample ID + batch
rgc_list <- SplitObject(
  rgc,
  split.by = "sample_batch"
)

# 4. SCTransform each split object
rgc_list <- lapply(rgc_list, function(x) {
  SCTransform(
    x,
    vars.to.regress = c(
      "percent.mt",
      "percent.ribo"
    ),
    verbose = FALSE
  )
})

# 5. Select 3000 anchor features
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(
  object.list = rgc_list,
  nfeatures = 3000
)

# 6. Prep SCT integration
rgc_list <- PrepSCTIntegration(
  object.list = rgc_list,
  anchor.features = features
)

# 7. Find anchors
anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = rgc_list,
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  anchor.features = features
)

# 8. Integrate data
rgc_integrated <- IntegrateData(
  anchorset = anchors,
  normalization.method = "SCT"
)

# 9. Standard Seurat workflow
DefaultAssay(rgc_integrated) <- "integrated"

rgc_integrated <- RunPCA(rgc_integrated, verbose = FALSE)

atlas_scree <- ElbowPlot(
  rgc_integrated,
  ndims = 20
)

atlas_scree

rgc_integrated <- RunUMAP(
  rgc_integrated,
  dims = 1:15
)

rgc_integrated <- FindNeighbors(
  rgc_integrated,
  dims = 1:15
)

rgc_integrated <- FindClusters(
  rgc_integrated,
  resolution = 0.5
)


ggsave(
  "RGC_integrated_scree_plot.pdf",
  plot = atlas_scree,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)

# 10. Subset Mafb-associated Tran clusters
mafb_clusters <- c(
  "23_W3D2",
  "30_Novel",
  "34_Novel",
  "39_Novel",
  "43_AlphaONS",
  "45_AlphaOFFT"
)

mafb <- subset(
  rgc_integrated,
  subset = Cluster %in% mafb_clusters
)

# 11. Re-run dimensionality reduction on Mafb subset
DefaultAssay(mafb) <- "integrated"

mafb <- RunPCA(mafb, verbose = FALSE)

mafb_scree <- ElbowPlot(
  mafb,
  ndims = 20
)

mafb_scree

ggsave(
  "MAFB_subset_scree_plot.pdf",
  plot = mafb_scree,
  width = 7,
  height = 5
)


# -----------------------------
# Test different PC numbers
# -----------------------------

pc_values <- 5:15

pc_results <- list()

for (pc in pc_values) {
  
  message("Running PCs 1:", pc)
  
  mafb_pc <- mafb
  
  mafb_pc <- RunUMAP(
    mafb_pc,
    dims = 1:pc,
    reduction.name = paste0("umap_pc", pc),
    reduction.key = paste0("UMAPPC", pc, "_")
  )
  
  mafb_pc <- FindNeighbors(
    mafb_pc,
    dims = 1:pc,
    graph.name = paste0("SCT_snn_pc", pc)
  )
  
  mafb_pc <- FindClusters(
    mafb_pc,
    graph.name = paste0("SCT_snn_pc", pc),
    resolution = 0.3,
    cluster.name = paste0("seurat_clusters_pc", pc)
  )
  
  p1 <- DimPlot(
    mafb_pc,
    reduction = paste0("umap_pc", pc),
    group.by = "Cluster",
    label = TRUE
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Tran clusters, PCs 1:", pc))
  
  p2 <- DimPlot(
    mafb_pc,
    reduction = paste0("umap_pc", pc),
    group.by = paste0("seurat_clusters_pc", pc),
    label = TRUE
  ) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Seurat clusters, PCs 1:", pc))
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("MAFB_umap_TranClusters_PC", pc, ".pdf"),
    plot = p1,
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("MAFB_umap_SeuratClusters_PC", pc, ".pdf"),
    plot = p2,
    width = 10,
    height = 8
  )
  
  cluster_table <- table(
    mafb_pc$Cluster,
    mafb_pc[[paste0("seurat_clusters_pc", pc)]][, 1]
  )
  
  write.csv(
    as.data.frame.matrix(cluster_table),
    paste0("MAFB_cluster_table_PC", pc, ".csv")
  )
  
  pc_results[[paste0("PC", pc)]] <- list(
    object = mafb_pc,
    tran_plot = p1,
    seurat_plot = p2,
    cluster_table = cluster_table
  )
  
  rm(mafb_pc)
  gc()
}

print(mafb[["pca"]], dims = 1:15, nfeatures = 10)

pca_loadings <- Loadings(mafb[["pca"]])

write.csv(
  pca_loadings,
  "MAFB_PCA_gene_loadings.csv"
)

sink("MAFB_PCA_loadings_PC1_100.txt")

print(
  mafb[["pca"]],
  dims = 1:9,
  nfeatures = 100
)

sink()

```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Re-run MAFB subset using first 9 PCs
# -----------------------------
DefaultAssay(mafb) <- "integrated"

mafb <- RunPCA(mafb, verbose = FALSE)

mafb <- RunUMAP(
  mafb,
  dims = 1:9
)

mafb <- FindNeighbors(
  mafb,
  dims = 1:9
)

mafb <- FindClusters(
  mafb,
  resolution = 0.3
)

# plots
mafbplot <- DimPlot(
  mafb,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "Cluster",
  label = TRUE
)

mafbplot

ggsave(
  "mafb_umap_clusters_PC9.pdf",
  plot = mafbplot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)

seuratplot <- DimPlot(
  mafb,
  reduction = "umap",
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  label = TRUE
)

seuratplot

ggsave(
  "mafb_umap_seurat_clusters_PC9.pdf",
  plot = seuratplot,
  width = 10,
  height = 8
)

table(mafb$Cluster, mafb$seurat_clusters)
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# DEGs for original Tran clusters
# -----------------------------
DefaultAssay(mafb) <- "SCT"

mafb_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  mafb,
  group.by = "Cluster",
  assay = "SCT",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

write.csv(
  mafb_markers,
  "MAFB_Tran_clusters_markers_SCT_PC9.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# set desired Tran cluster order
mafb$Cluster <- factor(
  mafb$Cluster,
  levels = c(
    "23_W3D2",
    "30_Novel",
    "43_AlphaONS",
    "34_Novel",
    "39_Novel",
    "45_AlphaOFFT"
  )
)

# top 10 markers per Tran cluster
top_markers <- mafb_markers %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^mt-", gene, ignore.case = TRUE),
    !grepl("^Rp[sl]", gene)
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()

top_genes <- unique(top_markers$gene)

DefaultAssay(mafb) <- "SCT"

heatmap_plot <- DoHeatmap(
  mafb,
  features = top_genes,
  group.by = "Cluster",
  size = 3
) +
  NoLegend()

heatmap_plot

ggsave(
  "MAFB_cluster_DEG_heatmap_PC9.pdf",
  plot = heatmap_plot,
  width = 14,
  height = 10
)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(mafb) <- "RNA"

mafb <- NormalizeData(mafb)

# normalized expression matrix
expr <- GetAssayData(
  mafb,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "data"   # <- changed from slot
)

clusters <- sort(unique(mafb$seurat_clusters))

shared_summary <- lapply(clusters, function(clust) {

  cells <- colnames(mafb)[
    mafb$seurat_clusters == clust
  ]

  mat <- expr[, cells]

  data.frame(
    gene = rownames(mat),
    cluster = clust,
    pct_expressing = rowMeans(mat > 0) * 100,
    avg_expression = rowMeans(mat)
  )

}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# define shared genes
shared_genes <- shared_summary %>%
  filter(
    !grepl("^mt-", gene, ignore.case = TRUE),
    !grepl("^Rp[sl]", gene)
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    min_pct = min(pct_expressing),
    mean_pct = mean(pct_expressing),
    mean_expression = mean(avg_expression),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(min_pct >= 25) %>%     # shared in every cluster
  arrange(desc(mean_expression))

# top 10
top10_shared <- head(shared_genes, 10)

top10_shared

shared_dotplot <- DotPlot(
  mafb,
  features = top10_shared$gene,
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme_classic()

shared_dotplot

ggsave(
  "MAFB_top10_shared_genes.pdf",
  plot = shared_dotplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)

shared_summary %>%
  filter(gene == "Mafb")
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Get top 10 genes for PC1 and PC2
# -----------------------------
pca_loadings <- Loadings(mafb[["pca"]])

pc1_pos <- names(sort(pca_loadings[, "PC_1"], decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
pc1_neg <- names(sort(pca_loadings[, "PC_1"], decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]

pc2_pos <- names(sort(pca_loadings[, "PC_2"], decreasing = TRUE))[1:10]
pc2_neg <- names(sort(pca_loadings[, "PC_2"], decreasing = FALSE))[1:10]

pc_genes <- unique(c(pc1_pos, pc1_neg, pc2_pos, pc2_neg))

pc_gene_table <- data.frame(
  PC = c(
    rep("PC1_positive", 10),
    rep("PC1_negative", 10),
    rep("PC2_positive", 10),
    rep("PC2_negative", 10)
  ),
  gene = c(pc1_pos, pc1_neg, pc2_pos, pc2_neg)
)

pc_gene_table

write.csv(
  pc_gene_table,
  "PC1_PC2_top10_genes.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
mafb$Cluster <- factor(
  mafb$Cluster,
  levels = c(
    "23_W3D2",
    "30_Novel",
    "43_AlphaONS",
    "34_Novel",
    "39_Novel",
    "45_AlphaOFFT"
  )
)

DefaultAssay(mafb) <- "RNA"
mafb <- NormalizeData(mafb)

pc12_dotplot <- DotPlot(
  mafb,
  features = pc_genes,
  group.by = "Cluster",
  assay = "RNA"
) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme_classic()

pc12_dotplot

ggsave(
  "PC1_PC2_top10_genes_by_TranCluster_dotplot.pdf",
  plot = pc12_dotplot,
  width = 14,
  height = 5
)
DefaultAssay(mafb) <- "RNA"

pc12_featureplot <- FeaturePlot(
  mafb,
  features = pc_genes,
  reduction = "umap",
  ncol = 5,
  order = TRUE
)

pc12_featureplot

ggsave(
  "PC1_PC2_top10_genes_featureplots.pdf",
  plot = pc12_featureplot,
  width = 18,
  height = 14
)
```
